name: Morwen Ashgrave
greetings: Kill enough of their kind and the big one comes looking for you. Be ready when it does.
Spawners? Start with rabbits. Five thousand of them. Then we'll talk about chickens.
Mobs from spawners don't count for my quests. The bosses can tell.
Die out there and the fee's gone. I don't do refunds.
Bring me ash, silk, marrow or void. The Artisan Bench knows what to do with them.
